title: Warm Middle Eastern Cabbage Baba Ganoush
description: A citrusy and fluffy Middle Eastern dish featuring cabbage and ferment-jang, perfect for a snack or light lunch. This jain-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional baba ganoush.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the shredded cabbage with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Roast the cabbage in the oven for 20 minutes, or until it is tender and lightly browned.
In a blender or food processor, combine the roasted cabbage, ferment-jang, lemon juice, garlic, and tahini.
Blend the mixture on high speed until it is smooth and creamy.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly pour in the remaining 3 tablespoons of olive oil.
Transfer the baba ganoush to a serving bowl and garnish with a sprinkle of paprika.
Serve the baba ganoush warm, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
